::: {#exm-feature}

#### Features of a quadratic fit

Let the one [covariate](#def-covariate) be a patient's age $\predvar$.
The [preprocessing](#def-preprocessing) $\featmap\paren{\predvar} = \tp{\sb{1, \predvar, \predvar^2}}$ has three [features](#def-feature): $1$, $\predvar$ and $\predvar^2$.
The covariate is one number, and the [model family](#def-model-family) receives three.

:::
